All public source declarations in the production modules, plus the four public Nonrepresentable3x3 example declarations and public structure/inductive constructors and projections, including the derived DecidableEq instance for OperationKind. Private declarations, internal/generated proof auxiliaries, recursors, test modules and private demonstration fixtures are excluded. Imported dependency declarations are not duplicated.
